```yaml
name: Unit Tests

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    env:
      PYTHONUNBUFFERED: 1

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'

      - name: Install uv
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install uv

      - name: Cache uv dependencies
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.cache/uv
          key: uv-${{ hashFiles('**/pyproject.toml') }}
          restore-keys: |
            uv-

      - name: Install dependencies (including dev)
        run: uv sync --dev

      - name: Run unit tests
        run: uv run pytest
```
